config_name: MacBook Air 15-inch — M5 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU, 24GB RAM, 512GB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: 66.5Wh cell; RAM tier has negligible runtime impact.

reviews.quote: There is just nothing comparable in the Windows world.
Outstanding battery life... easily last through a full workday without needing to recharge.
For many, it's the best Mac around.

praises: 24GB on the big silent Air — the comfort pick for heavy multitaskers who don't need a Pro
15.3-inch screen plus six great speakers makes a real desktop feel at 1.51 kg
Two-workday battery in light use (Amazon.ca reviews)
Fastest single-core CPU available, entirely fanless (NBC)
complaints: +C$300 for 24GB and it's still soldered forever (universal complaint)
Two ports; no HDMI/SD despite desktop-replacement size (NBC con)
Fanless throttling on sustained all-core loads

design_philosophy: RAM-forward big Air: the 24GB tier of the 15-inch for buyers who want headroom for years of tabs, IDEs and on-device AI without Pro pricing or fan noise.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from directly-tested Air 15 M5 base (NBC 92%): +0.4 productivity / +0.8 ai_ml for 24GB vs 16GB. Image follows Apple specs-page CDN pattern. Sentiment from NBC cons + Amazon.ca aggregate; Reddit API blocked (403). RTINGS score quoted from the same-generation 13-inch M5 review (identical platform).
